chrome_probes.panel_text:
Tips
Time
Most scenes take 30–60 minutes of in-game time. Sleeping advances to the next morning. Days end at midnight.
Trust
NPC trust climbs when you spend time on their stuff and decays roughly 1.0/day when you ignore them. Whichever number is lower in your sidebar is the bottleneck — work that one.
Hygiene
Drops with sweat (work, intimate scenes, exercise). Below 40, the diner manager docks your tips. Shower in the Bathroom; the morning routine handles it free of charge.
Energy
Drops with effort. Below 30, activity outcomes shrink — bookkeeping pays less, work earns less. Sleep restores fully; a Nap is faster but costs hygiene.
Money
Two steady earners: Frank's bookkeeping (weekday afternoons, +$8 + trust) and diner shifts with Marge (evenings, larger payouts but tips depend on hygiene). Rent is due Sunday morning — miss it and you're out.
Corruption & Beauty
Beauty rises when Maya showers and sketches — it shapes how NPCs first notice her. Corruption climbs as she pushes things further with Frank. Both gate certain scene branches, so keep an eye on the sidebar.
Reading the Quests page
Each card is a one-line journal thought. The thought changes as state changes — if Maya's voice shifts on the same arc, you've crossed a threshold worth following up on.
